representation_policy.geometric_figures: A geometric quotient polygon is an independently authored accessible SVG master with a lossless reader-sized PNG fallback. The torus and Klein-bottle assets preserve their labeled source models; the genus-two asset is an explicitly disclosed edition-original equivalent standard polygon, not a literal redraw of the source's cyclic edge arrangement.
representation_policy.algebraic_displays: Long exact sequences, chain complexes, projection composites, and null-homotopy calculations remain semantic reader displays so symbols, maps, and reading order stay selectable and accessible.
representation_policy.color_policy: Color is redundant: every oriented edge also carries an arrow and a textual label, and every SVG supplies title/description accessibility text.
representation_policy.reader_policy: Use the SVG as the primary reader asset, the paired PNG as fallback, and the Indonesian alt-text recommendation below at the inclusion site. Semantic displays must expose their mathematical text directly rather than use an image-only alt surrogate.
